assumptions: Correction cell rings represent physical source spaces with horizontal floor/ceiling boundaries.
Contacts describe adjacency, not traversability or EnergyPlus surface pairing.
Only explicit openings are represented; absent observations do not establish a solid wall.
Source boundary identity follows cell identity and ring order; topology edits need identity migration.
No elevation/section supplied: z_floor=0, ceiling 3.0m, door height 2.1m, window sill 0.9m and head 2.4m are EXPLICIT ASSUMPTIONS, not observations.
Exterior wall thickness taken as the annotated 240mm; the drawn grey band is ~11px (~300mm) including finish; openings are placed on the outer-face plane.
Interior partitions drawn ~5px double lines; nominal 120mm assumed for thickness reporting only (BIM paths are midplanes).
Room roles inferred from furniture symbols (desks, meeting tables, conference oval, lounge counter), not from labels.
Door operating states unknown; swing directions read from leaf+arc symbols.
Plan spaces were compiled deterministically from the declared footprint and physical partition segments; no snapping, extension, clipping, or inferred partition was applied.
